primitives.name: Gauge Ring Fill On Load

primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'A(t)': 'Area filled at time t (dimensionless)', 'A_0': 'Total area (dimensionless)', '\\lambda': 'Characteristic loading time constant (seconds)'}
primitives.assumptions: Exponential filling model assumes constant data arrival rate; ignores initial transient spikes or network latency fluctuations.

primitives.name: Number Count-Up Stat Card
primitives.verbatim_quote: cockpit: gauge ring fill on load, number count-up on stat cards, smooth hover/focus transitions, and subtle
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'N(t)': 'Count at time t', 'N_0': 'Initial count (integer)', '\\Delta N_i': 'Increment at discrete step i (integer)', '\\delta t': 'Fixed time interval per increment (seconds)'}
primitives.assumptions: Discrete counting model assumes uniform increments and fixed timing; neglects bursty data arrivals or rounding errors.

layer2.telemetry: Mean inter-count interval, reflecting data stream rate consistency.
